access.summary: Hunting is permitted with restrictions on the Connecticut Lakes Headwaters forest, per the state's posted forest rules.
restrictions: Follow Res 7301.10. No firearm discharge within 300 ft of developed recreation areas when occupied.
No camping and no fires on the property.
ATVs, trail bikes and snowmobiles only on trails designated by the Bureau of Trails.
Land is privately owned under a state conservation easement; logging traffic and road conditions change. Respect gates and closures.

Roads: the state's draft road plan says the road system is open to registered, inspected road vehicles from about mid-May until about Dec 15, with some roads gated; most gates are open during moose season. Never drive around a closed gate.

access.summary: Dartmouth's hunting brochure says the Second College Grant is open to public hunting, except areas temporarily closed for logging, research or safety. Plan to walk in.
restrictions: The public can't drive in at any time of year: vehicle passes are only for Dartmouth-affiliated visitors and their guests, and none are issued Oct 1 - Nov 28. Walk in from the gates; foot travel is welcome any time.
Report deer and bear to the gatekeeper at the main gate off Route 16.
No baiting. No road hunting. No shooting within 15 ft of open roads or marked trails or within 300 ft of a cabin.
No ATVs or snowmobiles to haul out game. No camping or open fires.
